summary: Diff implements an 11-screen slideshow with new intro, updated boy-with-glasses themed question/celebration effects, new story page, and a closing note page. Two notable spec mismatches are the exact Page 11 closing text formatting and the pre-intro theme text (missing the word “love”). Also, an unrequested promotional footer was added to the closing screen.

missing_requirements.requirement: Page 11 closing screen displays the text exactly “Happy Valentine Day my love my future wifey” and includes an editable note box.
missing_requirements.reason: The closing screen splits the required exact sentence into two separate headings (“Happy Valentine Day” and “my love my future wifey”), so the exact string does not appear as specified.

missing_requirements.requirement: Update the pre-Page 1 intro animation to match the requested theme “Happy Valentine Day love with hearts” while keeping reduced-motion fallback behavior.
missing_requirements.reason: Pre-intro displays “Happy Valentine Day” with hearts, but the word “love” is not present in the displayed text shown in the diff.

hallucinated_features.description: Added a promotional footer linking to caffeine.ai on the final/closing screen.
hallucinated_features.reason: BuildRequest does not request adding any footer, attribution, or external promotional link.
